entries.source:
You have learned to sing the praises of the Sun, in the form of three defensive Chants.
			Chant of Fortitude: Increases your mental save by %d and maximum life by %d%%.
			Chant of Fortress: Increases your physical save by %d, your physical resistance by %d%%, your armour by %d and your armour hardiness by 15%%.
			Chant of Resistance: Increases you spell save by %d, your fire/cold/lightning/acid resistances by %d%% and reduces all damage that comes from distant enemies (3 spaces or more) by %d%%.
			You may only have one Chant active at a time.
entries.target:
你学会了三种防御赞歌，以此咏唱对太阳的赞颂：
			坚韧赞歌：增加 %d 精神豁免， %d%% 最大生命值
			堡垒赞歌：增加 %d 物理豁免， %d%% 物理抗性， %d 护甲，15%% 护甲强度
			元素赞歌：增加 %d 法术豁免， %d%% 火焰/寒冷/闪电/酸性抗性，距离三格及以上的敌人对你造成的伤害变化 %d%%。
			你同时只能激活一种赞歌。

entries.source:
Your weapon attacks burn with righteous fury, dealing %d%% of your lost HP as additional Fire damage (up to %d, Current:  %d).
		Targets struck are also afflicted with a Martyrdom effect that causes them to take %d%% of all damage they deal for 4 turns.
		The bonus damage can only occur once per turn.
entries.target:
你的近战攻击命中时，造成相当于你已损失生命值 %d%% 的额外火焰伤害（至多 %d 点，当前 %d 点）。
		同时令目标进入殉难状态，持续 4 回合：其每次造成伤害，自身也会受到相当于该伤害 %d%% 的伤害。
		额外伤害每回合最多触发一次；触发额外伤害后，本回合不再施加殉难效果。

entries.source:
Even now, something compels you to sing.
			Dirge of Famine: Increases health regen by %d.
			Dirge of Conquest: Gives you part of a turn on critical (10%%) or kill (%d%%).
			Dirge of Pestilence: Shields you for %d when an enemy inflicts a detrimental effect on you (5 turn cooldown).
			You may only have one Dirge active at a time.
entries.target:
即便如今，仍有什么驱使着你歌唱。
			饥荒挽歌：增加生命回复 %d。
			征服挽歌：暴击时获得 10%% 回合的行动时间，杀死敌人时获得 %d%% 回合的行动时间。
			瘟疫挽歌：你受到非自身施加、且不属于“其他”类型的负面效果时获得 %d 的护盾（5 回合冷却）。
			你同时只能激活一种挽歌。

entries.source:
Fire a glowing orb of light at each enemy within your Radiance.  Each orb will slowly follow its target until it connects, dealing %d light damage to anything else it contacts along the way.  When the target is reached the orb will explode dealing %d light damage in radius 1 and healing you for 50%% of the damage dealt.
		All targets struck by your Judgement will be blighted by light, reducing saves by %d, reducing critical power by %d%%, and causing light damage received to splash in radius 2 for %d%% damage against all hostile targets for 4 turns.
entries.target:
在你的光辉中，向每一个敌人发射一个发光的球体。球体会缓慢追踪目标，直到击中目标，对它沿途接触到的其他物体造成 %d 点光系伤害。当到达目标时，球体将爆炸，在半径 1 格范围内造成 %d 点光系伤害，并为你恢复相当于该伤害 50%% 的生命值。
		每个球体追踪的目标都会受到光之枯萎：全豁免降低 %d， 暴击伤害加成降低 %d%%； 其受到你造成的超过 80 点的光系伤害时，该伤害的 %d%% 会溅射至半径 2 内的所有敌对目标（每回合最多一次），持续 4 回合。

entries.source:
A furious ice storm rages around the user doing %0.2f cold damage in a radius of 3 each turn for %d turns.
		It has 25%% chance to freeze damaged targets.
		The damage and duration will increase with your Willpower.
entries.target:
一阵激烈的冰风暴环绕施法者，每回合在 3 格范围内造成 %0.2f 寒冷伤害，持续 %d 回合。
		有 25%% 几率使受伤害目标被冰冻。
		受意志影响，伤害有额外加成。

entries.source:
Bites the target for %d%% weapon damage, potentially causing it to bleed for %d%% weapon damage over five turns.
		If the target is affected by the bleed it will send the devourer into a frenzy for %d turns (which in turn will frenzy other nearby devourers).
		The frenzy will increase global speed by %d%%, physical crit chance by %d%%, and prevent death until -%d%% life.
entries.target:
咬伤目标，造成 %d%% 武器伤害，可能让目标进入流血状态，在五回合内造成 %d%% 武器伤害。
		如果咬中且目标未免疫流血，吞噬者就会进入狂热状态 %d 回合（也会让周围的其他吞噬者进入狂热状态）。
		狂热状态会增加全局速度 %d%%， 物理暴击率 %d%%， 并使其在生命值降至 -%d%% 时才会死亡。

entries.source: Summons %d void shards.  The void shards come into being destabilized and will suffer %0.2f temporal damage each turn for five turns.  If they die while destabilized they'll explode for %0.2f temporal and %0.2f physical damage in a radius of 4.
entries.target: 召唤 %d 个虚空碎片。碎片生成时处于不稳定状态，2 回合后开始每回合受到 %0.2f 时空伤害，持续 5 回合。若它们在此受伤阶段死亡，会爆炸，对半径 4 格内的所有生物造成 %0.2f 时空伤害和 %0.2f 物理伤害。

entries.source:
Activate the infusion to cure yourself of one random %s effect and reduce all damage taken by %d%% for %d turns.
Also removes cross-tier effects of the affected types for free.
entries.target:
激活纹身，随机解除你身上的%s负面效果各一个，并减少受到的所有伤害 %d%%， 持续 %d 回合。
同时除去对应类型的越层效果。

entries.source:
Activate the rune to summon a protective storm around you for %d turns.
			While active the storm will completely block all damage over %d up to %d times.
entries.target:
启动这个符文，在你的身边召唤一团保护性的风暴，持续 %d 回合。
			当符文生效时，风暴可以完全抵挡不低于 %d 点的伤害，最多 %d 次。

entries.source:
Increases your damage and resistance penetration on sleeping targets by %d%%.  Additionally, every time you slay a sleeping target, a Night Terror will be summoned for %d turns.
		The Night Terror's stats will scale with your Mindpower, as will the damage bonus to sleeping targets.
entries.target:
你对睡眠状态目标造成的伤害和抗性穿透提高 %d%%。 另外每当你杀死一个睡眠状态的目标，就会召唤出一只持续 %d 回合的暗夜恐魔。
		受精神强度影响，伤害按比例加成；暗夜恐魔的强度随你的等级提升。

entries.source:
Surround yourself with an elemental aura that stores damage you deal.
		Whenever you have stored %d damage of one type you unleash a powerful blast at a random enemy dealing %d damage of that type in radius %d and granting you one of the following effects:

		Physical:		Cleanses 1 physical debuff and grant immunity to physical debuffs for 2 turns.
		#PURPLE#Arcane:#LAST#		Increases your mind and spell action speeds by 30%% for 3 turns.
		#LIGHT_RED#Fire:#LAST#		Increases all damage dealt by %d%% for 3 turns.
		#1133F3#Cold:#LAST#		Turns your skin into ice for 3 turns increasing armor by %d and dealing %d ice damage to attackers.
		#ROYAL_BLUE#Lightning:#LAST#	Increases your movement speed by %d%% for 2 turns.
		#YELLOW#Light:#LAST#		Reduces all cooldowns by 20%% for 3 turns.
		#LIGHT_GREEN#Nature:#LAST#		Cleanses 1 magical debuff and grant immunity to magical debuffs for 2 turns.

		Each effect can only happen once per 10 player turns.  This does not count as a typical cooldown.
		The damage and some effect powers increase with your Cunning and the threshold with your level.
		%s
entries.target:
你被元素光环笼罩，存储你造成的伤害。
		当你积累的某类伤害达到 %d 时，你会对一名随机敌人释放一次强力爆炸，造成 %d 点该类型伤害，爆炸半径 %d 格，并使你获得以下效果之一：

		物理：		清除 1 个物理负面特效并给予 2 回合物理负面状态免疫。
		#PURPLE#奥术：#LAST#		增加你的精神和施法速度 30%%，持续 3 回合。
		#LIGHT_RED#火焰：#LAST#		增加你所造成的所有伤害 %d%%， 持续 3 回合。
		#1133F3#寒冷：#LAST#		将你的皮肤变成冰，增加护甲 %d， 对近战命中你的攻击者造成 %d 寒冰伤害，持续 3 回合。
		#ROYAL_BLUE#闪电：#LAST#	你的移动速度提升 %d%%， 持续 2 回合。
		#YELLOW#光系：#LAST#		技能冷却时间减少 20%%，持续 3 回合。
		#LIGHT_GREEN#自然：#LAST#		清除 1 个魔法负面特效并给予 2 回合魔法负面状态免疫。

		同种效果最多每 10 回合触发一次。这不是普通的技能冷却。
		伤害和部分效果强度受灵巧值加成，伤害阈值受等级加成。
		%s

entries.source:
You deal a massive blow to your foe, smashing it for 150%% weapon damage and knocking it back 4 tiles (ignoring knockback resistance or physical save).
		If the knockback makes it hit a wall, it will smash down the wall, deal an additional 350%% weapon damage and apply the Counterstrike effect.
entries.target:
对敌人进行一次猛击，造成 150%% 的武器伤害并击退目标 4 格（无视击退免疫和物理豁免）；攻击命中时还会对目标附加被反击特效。
		如果敌人在击退时撞上墙壁，墙壁会被撞毁且对敌人造成额外的 350%% 武器伤害。

entries.source: You veil yourself in shadows and let them control you. While in the veil you become immune to status effects, and gain %d%% all damage reduction. Each turn you blink to a nearby foe within range %d, hitting it for %d%% darkness weapon damage. While this goes on you cannot be stopped unless you are killed, and you cannot control your character.
entries.target: 你融入暗影并被其支配。笼罩在阴影中时，你对所有负面状态（「其他」类除外）免疫，并减少 %d%% 所受伤害；每回合你会闪现到半径 %d 内的一个敌人身边，对其造成 %d%% 暗影武器伤害。此技能激活期间，除非死亡，否则你无法被打断，且你无法控制你的角色。

entries.source:
For every turn where you take damage you have a %d%% chance to store a seismic charge.
		You can activate this spell to consume the charges, spawning a raging volcano that lasts for 2 turns per charges.
		Each turn the volcano spews 2 flaming boulders that deal %0.2f fire and %0.2f physical damage.
		The charges quickly fade when outside of combat.
		The damage increases with your spellpower.
entries.target:
每次受到伤害时，你有 %d%% 的几率存储一次地震能量，每回合至多存储一次。
		你可以主动使用这一技能，释放地震充能，召唤出一座火山，每层充能持续 2 回合。
		每个回合，火山会喷出 2 块熔岩巨岩，造成 %0.2f 火焰和 %0.2f 物理伤害。
		充能会在战斗外快速消退。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
Strike a blow with your weapon for %d%% blight damage.
		If the attack hits a demonic seed tries to take hold inside your foe and you follow up with a shield strike dealing %d%% damage and dazing your target for %d turns.
		
		The seed requires a powerful host to nourish it and can only take hold in creatures that are worth experience and that are not summoned demons.
		The chance for the seed to take hold is based on the creatures rank:
		%sNormal#LAST#:  5%%
		%sElite#LAST#:  20%%
		%sRare#LAST# or %sUnique#LAST#:  50%%
		%sBoss#LAST#:  100%%
		When the host dies the seed fills with the vim of the dying creature and turns into a specific demon seed that can be used to summon that demon.
		If you already have a seed of the same time in your inventory or equipment it will instead increase its level if the host was of higher level than the seed and the demon inside will regenerate %d%% health and resurrect if it was dead.

		Higher talent levels allow for more powerful demon types.
		Implanting a seed into unique demons, if successful, will always try to grant a seed of that type, if available.
entries.target:
用武器打击目标，造成 %d%% 枯萎伤害。
		如果攻击命中，一颗恶魔种子会尝试在敌人体内扎根；随后你用盾牌猛击目标，造成 %d%% 伤害并使其眩晕 %d 回合。
		
		种子需要足够强大的宿主来成长，它只能寄生在值得获取经验值的生物体内，不能寄生在被召唤的恶魔体内。
		种子扎根的几率取决于生物的级别：
		%s普通生物#LAST#:  5%%
		%s精英生物#LAST#:  20%%
		%s稀有#LAST#或%s史诗生物#LAST#:  50%%
		%sBoss#LAST#:  100%%
		当宿主死亡时，种子将吸收宿主的活力，成长为一个特定的恶魔种子，能用于召唤恶魔。
		如果你的背包或装备中已有一颗恶魔种类与装备部位都相同的种子，则不会获得新种子，仅在宿主等级高于现有种子时提升其等级；同时，其中的恶魔会恢复 %d%% 生命值，若已死亡则会复活。

		技能等级越高，可获得的恶魔种类越强大。
		如果成功将种子植入恶魔体内，总会尝试给予与该恶魔同类型的种子（若有）。

entries.source:
You learn to use death around you to an even greater advantage. 
		Each time you kill or deal damage above %d%% of a creatures max life with non-darkness damage while Dark Reign is active the death will create a pool of dark energies of radius 1 for 5 turns.
		This pool spawns on top of a random enemy within radius %d.
		Any foes standing inside will take %0.2f darkness damage each turn.
		This effect can only happen once per turn.
		The damage increases with spellpower.
		At talent level 3 your Dark Reign buff also protects you from death until reaching %d life per stack.
entries.target:
你学会利用死亡来获取力量。
		当黑暗支配开启，每次你以任意类型的伤害杀死敌对生物或对其造成超过 %d%% 最大生命的伤害时，产生半径 1 的黑暗能量池，持续 5 回合。
		能量池将在半径 %d 范围内的随机敌人处生成。
		任何站在里面的敌人每回合将受到 %0.2f 点暗影伤害。
		这个效果每回合最多触发一次。
		伤害受法术强度加成。
		技能等级 3 或以上时，黑暗支配还能保护你免于死亡：每层使你的死亡下限降低 %d 点生命值。

entries.source: You consume the fear of enemies in radius %d, healing for %d life and gaining %0.1f%% of a turn for each stack up to a max of %.1f turns.
entries.target: 依据 %d 格内敌对生物身上的恐惧层数（恐惧不会被移除），每有一层恐惧，恢复 %d 生命，并获得相当于一回合 %0.1f%% 的额外行动时间，至多能获得 %.1f 个额外回合。

entries.source:
You unleash the fury of the Spellblaze, constantly draining your vim.
		While this spell is active at most two meteors will fall near your per turn, dealing %0.2f physical and %0.2f fire damage in radius 2.
		This spell disabled automatically on rest or run.
		The effects increase with spellpower.
entries.target:
你释放魔法大爆炸的力量，持续消耗活力。
		当技能开启时，每回合至多有 2 个陨石坠落在你身边，在半径 2 的范围内造成物理与火焰伤害，数值分别为 %0.2f 的一半与 %0.2f 的一半。
		这项法术在休息或跑步时自动关闭。
		效果受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
For a brief moment horrific hairs grow on your head, each of them ending with a creepy eye.
		You use those eyes to gaze upon a target area, creatures caught inside partially turn to stone reducing their movement speed by %d%% and making them brittle for 7 turns.
		Brittle targets have a 35%% chance for any damage they take to be increased by %d%%.
		This cannot be saved against.
entries.target:
短时间内你的头上生长出恐怖的头发，每根头发的末梢长着一只令人毛骨悚然的眼睛。
		你用这些眼睛凝视目标区域，使范围内的目标部分石化，降低其 %d%% 移速并使其处于 7 回合的脆弱状态。
		脆弱状态的目标每次受到伤害时有 35%% 几率使该次伤害变为原来的 %d%%。
		该效果不能被豁免。

entries.source:
You speak a chosen prophecy to the masses. When applying this prophecy, it will spread to all targets in radius %d.
		A prophecy can only be affected by one of Grand Oration, Twofold Curse or Revelation.
		
		Current prophecy: %s
entries.target:
你隆重地宣读某种预言，令其在目标周围 %d 格内传播。
		同一种预言只能被隆重演说、双重诅咒或天启中的一种强化。

		当前预言：%s

entries.source:
Weave your chosen prophecy into your speech, dooming your foe twice over. The chosen prophecy will apply instantly to your primary target whenever you cast any other prophecy at talent level %d.
		A prophecy can only be affected by one of Grand Oration, Twofold Curse or Revelation.
		
		Current prophecy: %s
entries.target:
将你选择的预言融入言辞，令敌人双重受咒。每当你施加其他预言时，你选择的预言将同时施加给主要目标 (技能等级 %d)。
		同一种预言只能被隆重演说、双重诅咒或天启中的一种强化。

		当前预言：%s

entries.source:
As you speak the chosen prophecy whispers from the void guide you in how to bring about the downfall of your foe. The chosen prophecy will grant one of the following effects.
		Prophecy of Madness. Each time the target uses a talent one of your talents on cooldown has its cooldown reduced by %d turns.
		Prophecy of Ruin. Each time the target takes damage you are healed for %d%% of the damage dealt.
		Prophecy of Treason: %d%% of all damage you take is redirected to a random target affected by Prophecy of Treason.
		A prophecy can only be affected by one of Grand Oration, Twofold Curse or Revelation.
	
		Current prophecy: %s
entries.target:
当你宣读预言时，来自虚空的回响将指引你带来敌人的末日。你选择的预言将提供以下三种加成之一。
		疯狂预言：每次目标使用技能时，你的一个正在冷却中的技能将减少 %d 回合冷却时间。
		毁灭预言：每次目标受到你造成的伤害时，你回复相当于该伤害 %d%% 的生命值。
		背叛预言：你受到的 %d%% 伤害将转移至周围随机受背叛预言影响的目标。
		同一种预言只能被隆重演说、双重诅咒或天启中的一种强化。

		当前预言：%s

entries.source:
Any time you deal damage with a psionic ability you incur a negative biofeedback in your foes, stacking up to %d times for 5 turns.
		Each stack reduces their physical save by %d, defense and armour by %d.
		This effect may only occur once per turn.
entries.target:
每当你使用精神技能造成伤害时，你对你的敌人施加一个负反馈，能叠加至 %d 层并持续 5 回合。
		每层都会使其物理豁免降低 %d 点，闪避与护甲降低 %d 点。
		这个效果每回合只能作用于一个目标，但同一目标在该回合内可多次叠层。

entries.source:
You repurpose your steam engine to emit a cloud of toxic, corrosive chemicals around you.
		Each time you use a non-instant steamtech talent, you create a radius 3 cloud of miasma for 5 turns. All enemies within the miasma have %d%% reduced healing and %d%% chance to fail talent usage.
		Each time miasma is reapplied the failure chance increases, up to %d%% after 5 reapplications.
		The first time each turn a target affected by miasma is hit by a melee or ranged attack the miasma seeps into their wounds, dealing an additional %0.2f acid damage.
		Miasma duration does not increase on re-apply.
		When a creature survives the miasma it becomes immune to it for 9 turns.
entries.target:
你改造蒸汽机，使其在你周围释放出一团有毒且具有腐蚀性的化学云雾。
		每当你使用一个非瞬发的蒸汽科技技能的时候，你会在周围产生半径为 3 格的瘴气云，持续 3 回合（重复触发时刷新）；云中的敌人会受到持续 5 回合的瘴气效果，治疗效果减少 %d%%， 且会有 %d%% 的几率使用技能失败。
		瘴气效果叠加的时候，敌人使用技能失败的几率也会上升，最多叠加五次，达到 %d%%。
		当被瘴气影响的目标每回合第一次被近战或远程攻击击中的时候，瘴气会渗入他们的伤口，额外造成 %0.2f 酸性伤害。
		再次施加瘴气时，持续时间不会延长。
		当一个生物在瘴气效果中存活下来后，它会免疫瘴气效果 9 回合。

entries.source:
You consume all Miasma Engine stacks you have to fire a blast of corrosive death through your steamgun, dealing %d%% weapon damage as acid in a radius %d cone with a %d%% chance to remove a random beneficial physical or mental effect. For every stack beyond the first the damage dealt is increased by 50%% and there is a %d%% chance to remove an additional effect.
		This attack ignores all enemy armour, and you must have at least 1 stack of Miasma Engine to use this talent.
entries.target:
你消耗所有瘴气引擎的叠加效果，并用你的蒸汽枪射出一道毁灭性的腐蚀冲击，在 %d 格范围的扇形区域内造成 %d%% 酸性武器伤害，并有 %d%% 的几率移除一个随机的有益物理或精神效果。每层瘴气引擎都会使伤害增加基础值的 50%%，并额外进行一次 %d%% 几率移除效果的判定。
		这一攻击无视敌人护甲，你至少需要有一层瘴气引擎效果才能使用这个技能。

entries.source:
You fire a special, electrically charged shot with your steamgun(s) at a spot within range.
		When each shot reaches its target, it bursts into electrified shrapnel within radius %d, which shocks each target hit and deals %d%% weapon damage as lightning.
		Shocked targets lose up to %d non-magical effects (for the first shot that hits).
		This talent does not use ammo.
entries.target:
你用蒸汽枪向射程内的一处位置进行一次特殊的带电射击。
		每发子弹抵达目标位置时，都会爆裂成电化弹片，波及半径 %d 格，电击命中的每个目标，并造成 %d%% 武器伤害的闪电伤害。
		被电击的目标失去至多 %d 个物理或精神增益效果（仅第一发命中时生效）。
		本技能不消耗弹药。

entries.source:
You rush to the target and strike with your tailsaw, dealing %d%% damage and taunting enemies within radius %d.
		You now also use your Dexterity in place of Strength when equipping Steamsaws as well as when calculating weapon damage, and have your Steamsaw damage increased by %d%% and Physical Power by %d.
entries.target:
你冲向敌人，用尾部蒸汽链锯进行攻击，造成 %d%% 伤害，并嘲讽该目标（标示的嘲讽半径为 %d 格，但实际只对所攻击的目标生效，无论是否命中）。
		装备蒸汽链锯的时候，你以敏捷代替力量来计算装备需求和武器伤害，并使你的蒸汽链锯伤害提高 %d%%， 物理强度提高 %d。

entries.source: Deals %0.2f occult damage per turn and each time a talent is used, the caster regens one turn of a random cooldown.
entries.target: 每回合造成 %0.2f 玄机伤害；目标每次使用技能（固有技能除外，如攻击、射击、装填及火焰喷射、暴风打击、弹矢爆射）时，施加者的一个随机冷却中科技法术（若没有则为法术）冷却时间减少 1 回合。
